answer: Require every agent to lock a small escrowed deposit before joining the orchard of services. Without it, an attacker can spawn a limitless ocean of sock-puppet identities at near-zero cost. The deposit is a narrow inlet: trivial for one honest agent, but forging ten thousand fake identities costs ten thousand deposits, and each deposit is forfeited when the identity misbehaves. Honest agents recover theirs through normal work, so sybil attacks become strictly unprofitable.
